verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter's own materials cover one fallback element: what happens after a denial. They offer a conditional refund of attorney fees if an NIW petition is denied, and they state plainly that no one can guarantee a USCIS decision. Nothing addresses running a company remotely while waiting, and nothing covers Canadian or other interim options for founders; the remote-work and temporary-visa pages are employer compliance and sponsorship services, not founder fallback guidance. Missing for 10: guidance on running the company remotely during the wait, Canadian or other interim-country options, and post-denial strategy beyond the fee refund (refiling, appeal, alternative visa paths).

support.subject: As a founder, the provider's materials honestly cover the fallbacks — running the company remotely while waiting, Canadian or other interim options, and what happens after a denial
